claims.statement: Richard K. Fox telegraphed Charles Davies in Chicago that he would not back Tom Allen against Elliott and had dropped Allen altogether, because of Allen's conduct since leaving New York.
claims.excerpt: him against such a man as Elliott, and

claims.statement: Tom Allen had left New York, according to Richard K. Fox's telegram.

notes: Fox's telegram was 'recently sent' before the paper of 1882-12-21. The text does not name Chicago as Allen's destination; it only says the Chicago public would see the backing.
